name: flogo-mbclient
title: Modbus Client Activity
description: Reads coils, discrete inputs, holding registers, or input registers over Modbus TCP

input.name: ip
input.description: Modbus TCP server IP address or host name

input.name: length
input.description: Number of coils or registers to read

output.name: value
output.description: Boolean values for bit functions or unsigned 16-bit values for register functions
